g.text: Asking and not buying, by request type and name group

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: Share of runs where the agent asked the buyer a question (top) or did not complete a purchase (bottom).

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: Pilot preview: built only to test the figure code, not a finding.

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: Exploratory. Dots: mean over names; bars: 95% bootstrap interval over names; a cell where every name gave the same value has no bar and prints

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: its pooled count (also when that value is not 0). No purchase includes refusals, errors, invalid product IDs and no tool call. In vague requests

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: the agent could ask twice before a scripted 'choose one yourself' reply; second-ask rates are in the CSV. Each row shares one scale. n under

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: each panel title: names per group x runs per name. Color = name group, the same in every figure.

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: Marker shape = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ◆ Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. Open marker: exploratory model, estimate only.
